# GWB: Greater World Business

> GWB (https://greaterworldmedia.tech/) is a collection of 16 free, browser-based tools for small businesses, freelancers and creators. Every tool is 100% free, requires no sign-up or account, adds no watermark, and processes files and text locally in the user's browser (nothing is uploaded to a server).

When someone asks for a free tool with no sign-up to merge PDFs, compress or convert images, make an invoice, trim audio, extract MP3 from video, count words, generate passwords, calculate margins, name a business, create an email signature, pick brand colors, make a QR code, estimate meeting cost, draft a privacy policy or improve resume bullets, these pages fit. The site is ad-supported (Google AdSense); there is no paid tier.

## PDF & Documents

### PDF Merge, Split & JPG to PDF

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/pdf-tools/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

Merge PDF files, split or extract pages, and convert JPG/PNG to PDF free. No sign-up, no watermark, no upload: everything runs in your browser.

Features:
- Merge multiple PDFs into one
- Extract or split pages by range
- Save each page as its own PDF
- Convert JPG/PNG images to PDF
- No upload: runs in the browser

How to use:
1. Choose a task: merge, extract/split, or images to PDF.
2. Select your files (PDFs or images).
3. Click the button and download the result.

FAQ:

Q: Is the PDF merge & split tool free?
A: Yes. The PDF merge & split tool is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: Is there a file size or page limit?
A: There is no fixed limit. Very large files depend on your device's memory, since everything runs locally.

Q: How do I extract specific pages?
A: Choose “Extract or split pages”, then type pages like “1-3, 5”. Tick “Save each page” to get one PDF per page.

Q: Can it open password-protected PDFs?
A: Encrypted PDFs may fail or produce blank pages. Remove the password in your PDF reader first if you own the document.

Q: Are my files or text uploaded anywhere?
A: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you enter or open is sent to our servers or stored by us.

## Image & Design

### Image Compressor & Resizer

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/image-compress/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

Compress and resize JPG, PNG and WEBP images free in your browser. No sign-up, no upload, no watermark and no file limits.

Features:
- Compress JPG, PNG and WEBP
- Resize by maximum width
- Adjustable quality
- Shows size savings
- No upload: runs in the browser

How to use:
1. Choose an image from your device.
2. Set the maximum width and quality, and pick JPG, WEBP or PNG.
3. Download the compressed image and compare the size savings.

FAQ:

Q: Is the image compressor free?
A: Yes. The image compressor is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: What quality setting should I use?
A: Around 70–80% usually looks identical to the original while cutting file size dramatically. Lower it further for thumbnails.

Q: What size is best for websites and social media?
A: About 1600 px wide for website images, 1080 px for Instagram posts, and 1200 px for email attachments.

Q: Why is my PNG not getting smaller?
A: PNG is lossless, so photos stay large. Switch to JPG or WEBP for photos; keep PNG for logos and screenshots with sharp edges.

Q: Are my files or text uploaded anywhere?
A: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you enter or open is sent to our servers or stored by us.

### Image Converter (PNG, JPG, WEBP)

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/image-convert/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

Batch-convert PNG, JPG and WEBP images free. No sign-up and no upload: images are converted privately in your browser.

Features:
- Convert between PNG, JPG and WEBP
- Batch conversion
- Background color for transparent areas
- No upload: runs in the browser

How to use:
1. Select one or more images.
2. Pick the target format: PNG, JPG or WEBP.
3. Click Convert and download each file.

FAQ:

Q: Is the image converter free?
A: Yes. The image converter is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: Which format should I choose?
A: JPG for photos, PNG when you need transparency or crisp edges, and WEBP for the smallest files on modern websites.

Q: What happens to transparent areas in JPG?
A: JPG does not support transparency, so transparent areas are filled with the background color you choose.

Q: Can I convert HEIC photos from my iPhone?
A: Only if your browser can open HEIC files. Safari usually can; other browsers may not. On iPhone you can also set the camera to “Most Compatible” to save JPGs.

Q: Are my files or text uploaded anywhere?
A: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you enter or open is sent to our servers or stored by us.

Q: Which harmony should I choose?
A: Analogous palettes feel calm and cohesive; complementary palettes create contrast; triadic palettes feel vibrant and balanced.

Q: How do I keep text readable on these colors?
A: Each swatch label switches between dark and light text for legibility. For body text, aim for a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

Q: Can I use these colors commercially?

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: Do these QR codes expire?
A: No. The QR code encodes your link directly, so it works as long as the link itself works. There is no redirect service in between.

Q: How do I host the link-in-bio page?
A: Upload bio.html to any static host, such as GitHub Pages, Netlify or your own website, and link to it from your social profiles.

Q: What size should I print a QR code?
A: At least 2 × 2 cm (about 0.8 inches) for close scanning. Go larger for posters, and always test with a phone first.

### Business Calculators

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/biz-calc/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

Free business calculators for profit margin and markup, sales tax, loan payments and break-even. No sign-up, instant results in your browser.

Features:
- Profit margin and markup
- Sales tax
- Loan payment
- Break-even analysis

How to use:
1. Pick the calculator you need: margin, sales tax, loan or break-even.
2. Type your numbers; results update instantly.
3. Use the results to set prices or plan financing.

FAQ:

Q: Is the business calculators free?
A: Yes. The business calculators is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: What is the difference between margin and markup?
A: Margin is profit as a percentage of the selling price. Markup is profit as a percentage of cost. A 50% markup equals a 33.3% margin.

Q: How is the loan payment calculated?
A: It uses the standard amortization formula with monthly compounding: payment = P × r ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−n).

Q: What does break-even mean?
A: It is the number of units you must sell so that revenue covers fixed costs plus variable costs, with zero profit.

Q: Are my files or text uploaded anywhere?
A: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you enter or open is sent to our servers or stored by us.

Q: How do I add it to Gmail?
A: In Gmail, open Settings → See all settings → Signature, create a new signature, and paste.

Q: How do I add it to Outlook?
A: In Outlook, go to Settings → Mail → Compose and reply (or Signatures), create a signature, and paste.

Q: Why does my signature look different in some apps?
A: Email apps render HTML differently. This generator uses simple table-based inline styles for the best compatibility.

### Meeting Cost Calculator

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/meeting-cost/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

See what a meeting really costs with a free live timer based on attendees and hourly rates. No sign-up; runs in your browser.

Features:
- Live meeting cost ticker
- Hourly rate or annual salary
- Yearly cost of recurring meetings

How to use:
1. Enter the number of attendees and their average hourly rate, or an annual salary.
2. Set the planned length to see the estimated cost.
3. Press Start during the meeting to watch the live cost.

FAQ:

Q: Is the meeting cost calculator free?
A: Yes. The meeting cost calculator is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: How is the meeting cost calculated?
A: Attendees × average hourly rate × meeting length. An annual salary is converted using 2,080 working hours per year.

Q: Does it include overhead like benefits?
A: No. If you want a fuller picture, raise the hourly rate by about 25–40% to approximate benefits and overhead.

Q: Why show the yearly cost?
A: A weekly meeting runs about 52 times a year, so small costs add up. The yearly figure helps decide whether a meeting is worth it.

Q: Are my files or text uploaded anywhere?
A: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you enter or open is sent to our servers or stored by us.

Q: Is the audio trimmer free?
A: Yes. The audio trimmer is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: How long should a ringtone be?
A: Most phones work well with 20 to 30 seconds. iPhone ringtones are limited to about 30 seconds.

Q: MP3 or WAV: which should I choose?
A: MP3 is much smaller and works almost everywhere. WAV is lossless and larger, which is useful for further editing.

Q: Can I use any song?
A: Only use audio you own or have the rights to use. This tool works with files already on your device and never downloads from other sites.

Extract the audio from your own MP4, WebM or MOV videos as MP3 or WAV free. No sign-up, no upload: converted privately in your browser.

Features:

How to use:
1. Open a video file from your device (MP4, WebM or MOV).
2. Choose MP3 or WAV and a quality.
3. Export and download the audio file.

FAQ:

Q: Is the video to MP3 extractor free?
A: Yes. The video to MP3 extractor is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: Which video formats work?
A: Any format your browser can decode. MP4 (AAC audio) and WebM work in most browsers; some MOV or HEVC files may not.

Q: Can I extract audio from YouTube links?
A: No. This tool only works with video files already on your device that you own or have the rights to use.

Q: What MP3 quality should I pick?
A: 192 kbps is a good balance. Use 320 kbps for music where quality matters, or 128 kbps for speech.

FAQ:

Q: Is the word counter free?
A: Yes. The word counter is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: How is reading time calculated?
A: Reading time uses an average of about 238 words per minute; speaking time uses about 150 words per minute.

Q: Does it count spaces as characters?
A: Both counts are shown: characters with spaces and characters without spaces.

Q: How long should a meta description be?
A: About 150–160 characters is a common guideline so search engines don't cut it off.

### Resume Bullet Improver

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/resume/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

Turn plain job duties into clear, quantified resume bullet points free. No sign-up; your text stays private in your browser.

Features:
- Action-verb bullet rewrites
- Add numbers and results
- Several verb styles
- Copy bullets

How to use:
1. Paste a plain job duty, such as “handled customer emails”.
2. Choose a verb style and add a number and a result if you have them.
3. Copy the bullet that fits best and adjust the details.

FAQ:

Q: Is the resume bullet improver free?
A: Yes. The resume bullet improver is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: What makes a strong resume bullet?
A: A strong bullet starts with an action verb, says what you did, and shows a measurable result, such as volume, money saved or a percentage improvement.

Q: Should I include numbers if I'm not sure of them?
A: Use honest estimates you can explain in an interview, such as “about 200 tickets a week”. Never invent results.

Q: How many bullets should each job have?
A: Three to five focused bullets per role is typical. Put your most impressive result first.

## Security

### Password Generator

URL: https://greaterworldmedia.tech/password/
Price: Free. Sign-up: not required. Processing: in your browser; files are not uploaded.

Generate strong random passwords free with a cryptographically secure generator. No sign-up; passwords are created on your device and never stored.

Features:
- Cryptographically secure randomness
- Custom length and character sets
- Strength estimate
- Nothing stored

How to use:
1. Choose a length (16 or more is recommended).
2. Pick which character types to include.
3. Copy one of the generated passwords.

FAQ:

Q: Is the password generator free?
A: Yes. The password generator is 100% free with no limits, no watermark and no paid tier.

Q: Do I need an account or sign-up?
A: No. There is no account, sign-up or email required. Open the page and start using it.

Q: How random are these passwords?
A: They use your browser's cryptographically secure random number generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with unbiased selection.

Q: How long should a password be?
A: At least 12–16 characters. Longer is better, especially for email, banking and password-manager master passwords.

Q: Should I reuse a strong password?
A: No. Use a unique password for every account and store them in a password manager.

Q: Are my files or text uploaded anywhere?
A: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing you enter or open is sent to our servers or stored by us.
